name: Fix Menu 1 Link 7 - Auto 2 DOCX Tanpa ZIP

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: zainnet-link7-dual-docx
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  apply-fix:
    name: Perbaiki 2 download Word dan cek build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository ZAIN.NET
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Setup Node 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm

      - name: Apply safe scoped patch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > /tmp/zainnet_link7_dual_word_patch.py <<'PY'
          #!/usr/bin/env python3
          """ZAIN.NET Menu 1 Link 7: 2 DOCX downloads, no ZIP, never auto-exit.

          Patch is idempotent. Run in the repository root.
          """
          from pathlib import Path
          import re


          def replace_once(source: str, old: str, new: str, label: str) -> str:
              n = source.count(old)
              if n != 1:
                  raise RuntimeError(f"{label}: expected exactly one matching section; found {n}; stopping safely")
              return source.replace(old, new, 1)


          app_path = Path('src/journalConverter/App.tsx')
          modal_path = Path('src/components/ToolViewerModal.tsx')
          cover_path = Path('src/journalConverter/utils/coverCdExport.ts')
          for path in [app_path, modal_path, cover_path]:
              if not path.is_file():
                  raise SystemExit(f"Missing {path} - run from ZAIN.NET repository root")

          app = app_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          if 'ZAINNET_LINK7_DUAL_WORD_AUTO_DOWNLOAD' not in app:
              app = replace_once(app,
                  "import { exportJournalToDocx } from './utils/docxExport';",
                  "import { buildJournalDocx, exportJournalToDocx } from './utils/docxExport';",
                  'Add DOCX generator import')
              app = replace_once(app,
                  "import { buildJournalBundle, triggerBundleDownload, downloadCoverCdOnly } from './utils/bundleExport';",
                  "import { triggerBundleDownload, downloadCoverCdOnly } from './utils/bundleExport';\nimport { buildCoverCdDocx } from './utils/coverCdExport';",
                  'Add separate cover Word generator')
              app = replace_once(app,
                  "  const [isDownloadingBundle, setIsDownloadingBundle] = useState(false);",
                  """  // ZAINNET_LINK7_DUAL_WORD_AUTO_DOWNLOAD
            // A prepared pair remains available if the browser blocks multiple downloads.
            const [preparedWordFiles, setPreparedWordFiles] = useState<{
              articleBlob: Blob; coverBlob: Blob; articleName: string; coverName: string;
            } | null>(null);
            const [preparingWordPair, setPreparingWordPair] = useState(false);
            const [wordDownloadNotice, setWordDownloadNotice] = useState('');
          """.rstrip(),
                  'Add download state')
              app = replace_once(app,
                  "  // Handle Journal AI Generation (Multi-stage process to prevent JSON truncation/timeouts)",
                  """  const safeWordName = (value: string) =>
              String(value || 'Mahasiswa').trim().slice(0, 45)
                .replace(/[\\/\\\\?%*:|\"<>]/g, '').replace(/\\s+/g, '_') || 'Mahasiswa';

            // Each file is a standalone DOCX, not a ZIP. Both blobs must be ready first.
            const buildTwoWordFiles = async (readyArticle: JournalArticle) => {
              const [articleBlob, coverBlob] = await Promise.all([
                buildJournalDocx(readyArticle), buildCoverCdDocx(readyArticle),
              ]);
              const title = safeWordName(readyArticle.metadata?.judul || 'Artikel_Ilmiah');
              const name = safeWordName(readyArticle.metadata?.nama || 'Mahasiswa');
              return {
                articleBlob, coverBlob,
                articleName: `Artikel_Jurnal_${title}.docx`,
                coverName: `Cover_CD_${name}.docx`,
              };
            };

            const triggerTwoWordDownloads = (files: {
              articleBlob: Blob; coverBlob: Blob; articleName: string; coverName: string;
            }) => {
              // Both requests are issued back-to-back. Browser download permissions
              // control whether they really arrive on the user's device.
              triggerBundleDownload(files.articleBlob, files.articleName);
              triggerBundleDownload(files.coverBlob, files.coverName);
              setWordDownloadNotice(
                'Dua unduhan Word (.docx) telah diminta. Periksa daftar unduhan browser. ' +
                'Jika Chrome/Firefox meminta izin download beberapa file, pilih Izinkan. ' +
                'Jika salah satu tidak ada, gunakan tombol Unduh 2 File Word Lagi atau tombol masing-masing.'
              );
            };

            // Handle Journal AI Generation (Multi-stage process to prevent JSON truncation/timeouts)""",
                  'Add two-word helpers')

              app = replace_once(app,
                  """      setArticle(fullArticle);
                onArticleComplete?.(`${(fullArticle.metadata as any)?.judul || 'Artikel'}.docx`);
                setGenerationStatus({ stage: 0, message: '', percent: 100 });
                setActiveTab('preview');""",
                  """      // Keep the article editor open. Account/quota completion is tracked
                // after AI generation, independently of the browser's download prompts.
                setArticle(fullArticle);
                setActiveTab('preview');
                onArticleComplete?.(`${(fullArticle.metadata as any)?.judul || 'Artikel'}.docx`);
                setGenerationStatus({ stage: 0, message: '', percent: 100 });

                setPreparingWordPair(true);
                setWordDownloadNotice('Artikel selesai. Menyiapkan 2 file Word secara terpisah...');
                try {
                  const files = await buildTwoWordFiles(fullArticle);
                  setPreparedWordFiles(files);
                  triggerTwoWordDownloads(files);
                } catch (downloadErr: any) {
                  console.error('Automatic two-file Word export failed:', downloadErr);
                  setWordDownloadNotice(
                    'Artikel berhasil dibuat, tetapi kedua file belum berhasil disiapkan: ' +
                    (downloadErr?.message || 'Terjadi gangguan saat ekspor Word.') +
                    ' Halaman tetap terbuka. Gunakan tombol unduh untuk mencoba kembali.'
                  );
                } finally {
                  setPreparingWordPair(false);
                }""",
                  'Generate automatic two DOCX without leaving page')

              app = replace_once(app,
                  "      onArticleComplete?.(`Artikel_${article.id}.docx`);",
                  "      // Quota already recorded after the 3 generation stages; re-download is free.",
                  'Avoid re-marking quotas on repeated DOCX downloads')

              marker_start = '  // Handle Complete Bundle Export (.zip Artikel + Cover CD)'
              marker_end = '  // Open Editor Modal for a specific section'
              if app.count(marker_start) != 1 or app.count(marker_end) != 1:
                  raise RuntimeError('Cannot locate ZIP exporter block; stopping')
              start = app.index(marker_start)
              end = app.index(marker_end, start)
              app = app[:start] + """  // Two separate Word downloads, triggered by an explicit click if browser
            // blocks the initial automatic downloads. Never navigate to the home page.
            const handleDownloadTwoWord = async () => {
              if (!article || preparingWordPair) return;
              setPreparingWordPair(true);
              try {
                // If the article has been edited, generate new files so changes are saved.
                const files = preparedWordFiles || await buildTwoWordFiles(article);
                setPreparedWordFiles(files);
                triggerTwoWordDownloads(files);
              } catch (err: any) {
                console.error('Two-file Word download error:', err);
                setWordDownloadNotice(
                  'Gagal menyiapkan dua file Word: ' + (err?.message || 'Silakan coba lagi.') +
                  ' Artikel tetap tersedia; Anda dapat mengunduhnya satu per satu.'
                );
              } finally {
                setPreparingWordPair(false);
              }
            };

          """ + app[end:]

              # Invalidate prepared downloads if the user edits either the article or footnotes.
              # This requires a wrapper instead of calling setArticle in several views directly.
              app = replace_once(app,
                  "  const [article, setArticle] = useState<JournalArticle | null>(null);",
                  """  const [article, setArticle] = useState<JournalArticle | null>(null);
            const handleUpdateArticleAndResetDownloads = (updated: JournalArticle) => {
              setPreparedWordFiles(null);
              setArticle(updated);
            };""",
                  'Invalidate cached downloads after editing')
              app = replace_once(app,
                  '            onUpdateArticle={setArticle}',
                  '            onUpdateArticle={handleUpdateArticleAndResetDownloads}',
                  'Hook article editor to cache invalidation')
              app = replace_once(app,
                  "      ...article,\n      footnotes: updatedFootnotes,\n    });",
                  "      ...article,\n      footnotes: updatedFootnotes,\n    });\n    setPreparedWordFiles(null);",
                  'Invalidate download cache on footnote editor')
              # All section edits (abstract and other sections) must invalidate the pair.
              app = replace_once(app,
                  "  const handleSaveSection = (sectionKey: string, newContent: string) => {\n    if (!article) return;",
                  "  const handleSaveSection = (sectionKey: string, newContent: string) => {\n    if (!article) return;\n    setPreparedWordFiles(null);",
                  'Invalidate Word cache for every edited section')
              # Hide the two ZIP actions without changing the other independent downloads.
              if app.count('onDownloadBundle={handleDownloadBundle}') != 2:
                  raise RuntimeError('Expected exactly two ZIP UI callbacks')
              app = '\n'.join(line for line in app.split('\n') if 'onDownloadBundle={handleDownloadBundle}' not in line)
              app = replace_once(app,
                  '        isDownloading={isDownloadingDocx || isDownloadingCoverCd || isDownloadingBundle}',
                  '        isDownloading={isDownloadingDocx || isDownloadingCoverCd || preparingWordPair}',
                  'Update header busy state')
              app = replace_once(app,
                  '            isDownloadingBundle={isDownloadingBundle}\n',
                  '',
                  'Remove ZIP busy state')

              app = replace_once(app,
                  '      <main className="flex-1 pb-16">',
                  """      <main className="flex-1 pb-16">
                  {article && (
                    <section role="status" aria-live="polite" className="max-w-5xl mx-auto mt-4 px-4">
                      <div className="bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-300 rounded-2xl p-4 text-indigo-950 shadow-sm">
                        <p className="font-bold text-sm mb-2">Artikel berhasil dibuat — 2 file Word terpisah</p>
                        <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed mb-3">{wordDownloadNotice || 'Menyiapkan file artikel dan Cover CD...'}</p>
                        <button type="button" onClick={handleDownloadTwoWord} disabled={preparingWordPair}
                          className="bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-indigo-600">
                          {preparingWordPair ? 'Menyiapkan dua file Word...' : 'Unduh 2 File Word Lagi (.docx)'}
                        </button>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-indigo-700">Halaman ini tidak akan kembali otomatis ke beranda. Pastikan kedua berkas muncul di folder Download sebelum Anda menutup modul.</p>
                      </div>
                    </section>
                  )}""",
                  'Add retry/permission banner')

          # The parent must not show its fullscreen completion overlay or navigate home
          # for link 7, but completion and quota are still recorded exactly once.
          modal = modal_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          if 'ZAINNET_LINK7_DUAL_WORD_STAY_OPEN' not in modal:
              pattern = re.compile(r'  const handleAutoFinishDownload = \(fileName: string, reason: string\) => \{[\s\S]*?\n  \};(?=\n  useEffect\(\(\) => \{)')
              new_handler = """  const handleAutoFinishDownload = (fileName: string, reason: string) => {
              if (!tool || done.current) return;
              // ZAINNET_LINK7_DUAL_WORD_STAY_OPEN
              // Link 7 reports generation success BEFORE the browser downloads anything.
              const keepArticleDownloadOpen = tool.id === 'art-7'
                || tool.url === 'internal://journal-converter'
                || tool.url === '/journal-converter';
              done.current = true;
              if (!keepArticleDownloadOpen) setCompleted(true);
              setStatus(keepArticleDownloadOpen
                ? 'Artikel selesai dibuat. Menyiapkan dua file Word; periksa panel unduhan dan izin browser.'
                : 'Hasil siap — transaksi dinyatakan selesai & mengamankan sesi...');
              recordSessionCompleted(tool, effectiveUserId, { fileName, reason }, [], 0);
              Promise.resolve(finishRef.current?.(tool, reason)).then(() => {
                if (!keepArticleDownloadOpen) {
                  setStatus(isAdmin ? 'Selesai — hasil berhasil dibuat.' : 'Selesai — transaksi selesai & kuota berhasil digunakan.');
                }
              }).catch((e) => setStatus(`Hasil siap; penyimpanan akun tertunda. ${e.message}`));

              // Never auto-close Link 7. The browser cannot verify that BOTH downloads
              // were actually saved. Users can confirm them and close manually.
              if (keepArticleDownloadOpen) return;

              setStatus('File berhasil diunduh! Transaksi dinyatakan selesai. Mengalihkan kembali ke halaman utama ZAIN.NET...');
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
                  window.history.pushState(null, '', '/');
                  window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));
                }
                onClose();
              }, 1500);
            };"""
              modal, count = pattern.subn(lambda m: new_handler, modal, count=1)
              if count != 1:
                  raise RuntimeError(f'Modal finish handler not uniquely identified: {count}')

          cover = cover_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          if "import.meta.env.BASE_URL" not in cover:
              cover = replace_once(cover,
                  "  const response = await fetch('/covercd-template.docx', { cache: 'force-cache' });",
                  "  const response = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}covercd-template.docx`, { cache: 'force-cache' });",
                  'Fix GitHub Pages base path for cover template')

          # Hard assertions before writing any of the three files.
          assert 'ZAINNET_LINK7_DUAL_WORD_AUTO_DOWNLOAD' in app
          assert 'onDownloadBundle={handleDownloadBundle}' not in app
          assert 'const handleDownloadBundle = ' not in app
          assert "buildCoverCdDocx(readyArticle)" in app
          assert 'setActiveTab(\'preview\')' in app
          assert 'ZAINNET_LINK7_DUAL_WORD_STAY_OPEN' in modal
          assert 'if (keepArticleDownloadOpen) return;' in modal
          assert 'import.meta.env.BASE_URL' in cover
          app_path.write_text(app, encoding='utf-8')
          modal_path.write_text(modal, encoding='utf-8')
          cover_path.write_text(cover, encoding='utf-8')
          print('SUCCESS: Menu 1 Link 7 patches applied to 3 files')
          PY
          python3 /tmp/zainnet_link7_dual_word_patch.py

      - name: Verify dual DOCX behavior
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          app = Path('src/journalConverter/App.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          modal = Path('src/components/ToolViewerModal.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          cover = Path('src/journalConverter/utils/coverCdExport.ts').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          checks = {
              'auto pairs Word exports': 'buildJournalDocx(readyArticle), buildCoverCdDocx(readyArticle)' in app,
              '2 distinct download triggers': 'triggerBundleDownload(files.articleBlob, files.articleName)' in app and 'triggerBundleDownload(files.coverBlob, files.coverName)' in app,
              'manual two-file retry': 'onClick={handleDownloadTwoWord}' in app,
              'no article ZIP UI': 'onDownloadBundle={handleDownloadBundle}' not in app,
              'preview remains open': 'if (keepArticleDownloadOpen) return;' in modal,
              'template path follows Vite base': 'import.meta.env.BASE_URL}covercd-template.docx' in cover,
              'article recorded once': app.count('onArticleComplete?.(') == 1,
          }
          for name, ok in checks.items():
              print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), name)
          if not all(checks.values()):
              raise SystemExit('Patch verification failed - no commit will be made')
          PY

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Verify website can build
        env:
          VITE_BASE_PATH: /Karyazainnet/
        run: npm run build

      - name: Commit patch after successful build
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -- src/journalConverter/App.tsx src/components/ToolViewerModal.tsx src/journalConverter/utils/coverCdExport.ts
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Patch already installed. Nothing to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "Link7: auto-download article and cover CD separately, keep preview open"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
